title: Project Staff: Junior Machine Operator, Production Coordinator and More
organization: Centre for Development of Imaging Technology (C-DIT)
age_limit: Not above 50 years (55 for Graphic Designer) on the date of notification
summary: C-DIT, an autonomous institution under the Government of Kerala, invites online applications for 30 temporary project staff positions in its Optical Image Processing and Security Products Division. Roles include Production Coordinator, Junior/Senior Machine Operator, and Graphic Designer. Selected candidates will work on a 1-year contract basis in Thiruvananthapuram.
eligibility_bullets: Age: Not above 50 years (55 for Graphic Designer) on the date of notification.
Education: Varies by post, ranging from SSLC/10th Pass, Plus Two/VHSE, Diploma/ITI in relevant fields, to BFA/Bachelor's Degree in Graphic Design/Animation.
Experience: Minimum 2 to 15 years of relevant experience is required, depending on the post and educational qualification.
Candidates must be willing to work in shifts (day/night).
how_to_apply_steps: Submit applications online by visiting www.careers.cdit.org.
Complete online registration and upload scanned copies of all supporting documents valid as on the closing date.
Remit the application fee of Rs. 300/- (SC/ST candidates are exempted) using the online link provided in the application portal.
Finally submit the application after verifying all details; changes can only be made before final submission.
Applicants are advised to regularly visit the website for any updates or changes in schedules/requirements.
